summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in jshelperdependenceny@1.0.0
details: The package jshelperdependenceny@1.0.0 contains a single scanned file with no observed install-time or import-time behavior that would harm an installer: no lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no reads of credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles), no environment-variable scraping, no outbound network calls to attacker-controlled destinations, no silent relay of caller-supplied data, and no persistence or backdoor mechanisms. The package name resembles a dependency-confusion-style lure, but name resemblance alone is not a supply-chain attack and the code present in this version does not perform any installer-side harmful action.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
